content.value: A steam power plant operates on Reheat cycle. The steam pressure and temperature are I 00 bar and $5 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathsf C$ respectively, and the condenser pressure is 0.04 bar. The reheat pressure and temperature are 8 bar and $5 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } ,$ respectively. Calculate (i) the quality of steam at turbine exhaust, (ii) the cycle efficiency considering pump work, (iii) ssc and work ratio, and (iv) compare the efficiency, if the cycle operates on Rankine cycle.
